summary: Enhance your skills with our EpiCollect Training Course. Learn mobile data collection techniques to streamline your research and improve data accuracy.
lede: EpiCollect5 mobile data collection uses a mobile app and web project environment to design forms and gather structured field records. For field data officers, research coordinators, and programme managers, the training covers configuring forms, applying validation rules, and managing field submissions. You practise checking GPS data, handling offline collection and synchronization, and preparing CSV or JSON exports for analysis.
audienceIntro: This mobile data collection course suits professionals who design, supervise, analyse, or govern structured field information using smartphones and tablets.
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. You should have basic workplace computer skills and practical familiarity with surveys, inspections, monitoring activities, research data, or field reporting. A laptop is recommended for form design and dataset exercises. Bring a representative field questionnaire or data collection requirement if available, with personal or confidential information removed.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
